name: Alma
one_liner: Insurance credentialing + AI notes + EHR for therapists at $125/month with higher negotiated reimbursement rates and weekly payments.
short_description: Alma is an all-in-one platform for independent therapists bundling insurance credentialing, billing, AI session notes, EHR, telehealth, and a client directory for $125/month.
long_description: Alma is an all-in-one platform for independent therapists that bundles insurance credentialing, in-network billing, AI session note-taking, EHR, scheduling, telehealth, and a client-facing therapist directory—all for $125/month (or $95/month billed annually). Alma credentials therapists with major insurers including Aetna, Cigna, Optum, Anthem, and select Blue Cross Blue Shield plans in under 45 days—3x faster than the average process. The platform often negotiates $10-30 higher reimbursement rates per session than therapists achieve through solo credentialing. Alma pays therapists weekly, eliminating long waits for insurance reimbursement. The AI notes feature processes telehealth session recordings for documentation (in-person sessions not supported). In January 2026, Alma was acquired by Spring Health, bringing it within one of the largest mental health platforms in the market. The platform replaces the need for separate credentialing services ($100-300/month), EHR software ($49-99/month), and directory listings ($30-50/month).
best_for: Independent therapists wanting predictable flat monthly fee ($125/month) over revenue sharing
Telehealth-focused clinicians who can use AI notes (video sessions only)
Solo practitioners wanting integrated EHR + billing + credentialing in one platform
Clinicians wanting transparent pricing where you keep 100% of reimbursements
Therapists who value weekly payments and community resources (CE, peer networking)
not_for: Therapists wanting a completely free platform (use Headway or Grow Therapy)
Clinicians doing primarily in-person sessions (AI notes only work for video)
Providers affected by late 2024 Optum rate cuts (rates reduced industry-wide)
Those building fully independent practice (credentials still belong to Alma)
Practitioners in areas with saturated Alma directory coverage
Clinicians who may leave and need portable credentials

faqs.q: How much does Alma cost for therapists?
faqs.a: Alma costs $125/month or $95/month when billed annually ($1,140/year). No free trial. You keep 100% of reimbursements (unlike revenue-sharing platforms). The fee is owed monthly regardless of caseload—factor this into your breakeven calculation.

faqs.q: How fast is credentialing through Alma?
faqs.a: Alma credentials therapists in under 45 days—3x faster than solo credentialing. However, these credentials belong to Alma. If you leave, you must re-credential independently (60-120 day process with potential income gap).

faqs.q: Does Alma negotiate higher reimbursement rates?
faqs.a: Alma claims to negotiate $10-30 higher rates than solo credentialing. However, late 2024 Optum rate cuts affected Alma providers significantly. Platform-negotiated rates can change without your input.

faqs.q: What happened with Optum rates in 2024?
faqs.a: In November 2024, Optum/UHC implemented rate cuts that reduced some Alma provider reimbursements. Because Alma negotiates on your behalf, providers had no direct say in these changes—a key tradeoff of platform credentialing.

faqs.q: Does Alma's AI notes work for in-person sessions?
faqs.a: No. Alma's AI notes only work for telehealth video sessions conducted through their platform. In-person therapists won't benefit from this feature and would need a separate AI scribe solution.

faqs.q: What happens if I leave Alma?
faqs.a: Your insurance credentials stay with Alma. You'd need to re-credential independently (60-120 days). Clients may or may not follow—those who found you via Alma's directory might simply find another in-network provider.

faqs.q: How does Alma compare to Headway and Grow?
faqs.a: Alma charges $125/month flat while Headway and Grow take undisclosed revenue cuts. Alma includes EHR and AI notes (video only). All three experienced 2024 Optum cuts. None give you portable credentials. Alma pays weekly; Headway bi-weekly; Grow weekly.
